name: Repair macOS Vision picker startup and Linux Canvas path-field focus identity
status: terminal-failed; one milestone push submitted; all 7 workflows and 20 jobs are terminal, with 6 workflows and 19 jobs passed; the Ubuntu round-trip job failed
bounded_outcome: Repair the terminal macOS first-run Vision OCR timeout and Linux Canvas path-field focus/identity failure so the pinned Obsidian reference round-trip reaches and completes C07.4 on all three CI platforms.
scope: Keep the migration goal's push-cadence heading explicit that CI submission occurs once per implementation-complete milestone, and update its recorded SHA-256 in requirements.json. This wording synchronization is part of this named milestone and does not create a separate push or CI batch.

macOS: replace repeated cold spawnSync swift OCR invocation with a bounded, reusable/cached compiled Swift Vision helper. Retain exact picker/window identity and Open/Cancel safeguards. Record helper build/cache hit, invocation duration, exit/timeout, OCR candidates, screenshot stage, and picker-open outcome.

Linux: instrument and repair Canvas path-field targeting with fresh screenshot and app-reported geometry. Record both response IDs and rectangles, pointer position, pixels-per-point, click receipt, focused widget before typing, and each field's value hash after entry. Before dispatching a click, compare its screenshot-derived position with the current app-reported path and sibling-ID rectangles and reject stale coordinates, including the observed 13 px layout shift. Retry only after refreshing the screenshot and both field observations; fail closed unless the exact requested path is read back from the path field and the sibling ID remains unchanged.

Preserve first-run authoring, exact field identity, no-write snapshots, and round-trip safety gates while restoring downstream C07.4 reference capture on Linux and macOS. Keep the Windows capture reference-only.
Keep the pinned Obsidian version, C07.4 scenario definitions, and expected reference semantics unchanged.
out_of_scope: C06.3 Canvas standard-field mutation and R2.8.138 protected-history-budget work.
Rust implementation of JavaScript-number or locale comparison semantics and any Rust parity claim.
Changing C07.4 fixtures, scenario definitions, pinned Obsidian version, or expected reference behavior.
Unrelated plugin, renderer, desktop, vault-product, C07.5, or C09.2 changes.
Local tests, builds, formatting, linting, validators, type checks, application launches, and runtime probes.
implementation_criteria: The migration goal explicitly says to submit once per implementation-complete milestone, never per minor change, and requirements.json.mapping_review.goal_sha256 matches the updated goal file.
The macOS Vision helper is compiled once per job/process and reused; helper startup/invocation is bounded, and diagnostics distinguish compilation/cache setup from OCR execution and timeout.
Picker confirmation still identifies the expected first-run control and native panel; Open and Cancel safeguards are unchanged and no OCR timeout is treated as a successful click.

Before each Linux click, a fresh pointer observation records both Canvas fields' response IDs, rectangles, pointer, and pixels-per-point. The screenshot-derived click must map inside the current target rectangle and outside the sibling rectangle; otherwise no click is dispatched and the screenshot/observations are refreshed.

Linux records which widget owns focus and receives each key event; every target/sibling diagnostic pair must have the same egui frame number. After each typed character, the target prefix/value must match by hash while the sibling ID remains unchanged. A sibling mutation stops the attempt immediately.

Retries are bounded and use newly captured screenshots and fresh field observations; ambiguous focus, sibling-field input, stale geometry, missing readback, or timeout fails closed with per-attempt diagnostics.
No vault writes are introduced by the reference harness; before/after snapshots remain attached and any reference-app mutation is reported without promoting source preservation or Rust parity.
ci_acceptance_criteria: All seven required GitHub Actions workflows and all 20 jobs pass on one exact submitted SHA.
Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows each complete all ten C07.4 scenarios on first open and reopen, with complete scenario and source-checkpoint reports.
The Linux report proves the exact requested Canvas path was entered in and read back from the path field, not the sibling ID field, before downstream C07.4 capture.
The macOS report proves bounded Vision helper execution and exact first-run picker confirmation before downstream C07.4 capture.

All platform artifacts, report hashes, exact-SHA workflow/job results, and reference-source checkpoints are reconciled; C07.4 remains reference-only, with no Rust-parity or source-preservation claim from reference observations.
